steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: For our friends joining us for the first time, if you're here for exquisite Yanese calligraphy or rare Sargonian treasures, I suggest you save yourself some time and leave now.

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: This here is a Script Auction, unique to Wrankwood, where unfinished ideas, drafts, and their associated copyrights are up for sale.

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: As such, unlike traditional auctions where anything put up must have its authenticity verified, we offer no guarantees as to the value of the items—

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: Whether it has marketing potential or artistic value, whether it will become Wrankwood's next timeless classic or a forgotten flop...

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: That is for you, and you alone, to decide.

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: To protect the intellectual property of the items on auction, you are asked to put away your terminals and turn off any recording equipment. And without further ado, allow me to introduce the first item—

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: The Death of Lady Dupont, a story of love and hatred taking place in Columbia, involving two blue-blood families in changing times. Bidding starts at one hundred thousand gold certificates.

spans.text: , a story of love and hatred taking place in Columbia, involving two blue-blood families in changing times. Bidding starts at one hundred thousand gold certificates.

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: One hundred thousand. We have a bid for one hundred thousand from the gentleman in the back... One hundred and fifty thousand from the pretty young lady on my left! Anyone else?

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: One hundred and fifty thousand going once...

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: One hundred and fifty thousand going twice...
Six hundred thousand.

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: (Whispers) Miss Stone! Are you here to ruin my auction? Placing such a high bid for the first item will only make the rest of it seem like an afterthought!

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I have no interest in slowly inching up the price. I simply bid what it's worth to me.

steps.name: Auctioneer
steps.text: I understand that it's your style to gamble lavishly on scripts, but think of your finances... Didn't quite a few of your recent films flop? Are you sure it's wise to spend so much?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I can afford your fee. Smack that hammer of yours, old friend.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: You have a rather talented young man here, and I'm eager to have a conversation with him.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Whiskey, please, no ice.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Would you like one too, my friend?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: My doctor has advised me to refrain from drink.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: That accent... are you from Sargon?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Interesting. That stern, sullen complexion of yours could not be more Victorian.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: (Sargonian) I have tread the sands of Sargon.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: (King's Victorian) But I was indeed born in Victoria.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: You switch between languages at ease, and your accents are flawless. But from what I can see in your habits, those aren't the only two countries you're familiar with.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I've been to Bolívar, Siracusa, Leithanien, Rim Billiton... and now, Wrankwood.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: —The entertainment capital of Terra. Pleasant weather and lots of sunshine—the perfect place to shoot movies. So what brings you here?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Research? Pleasure? Or perhaps you're like everyone else who came to seek fame and glory, most of whom end up at the extras market, fighting over bit roles to make ends meet?

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I'm looking for someone.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I've tracked his shadows across many lands, over the span of many years.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Oh? Who? I know all the film crews, whether they work downtown or on the nomadic plates. Maybe I could be of help.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: That won't be necessary.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I see, fair enough... What a shame though...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: If there's nothing else—

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: My name is Greta Stone. I'm a producer here at Wrankwood... a rather well-known one in the industry, if I might add.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I took you for the son of some noble, or a film school student who came to try your luck, and was hoping to invite you to join my film crew.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Everyone who comes to the Wrankwood Script Auction tends to have a passion for artistry, and I must admit you have a rather unique aura about you.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I was once an actor for a small theater troupe in Victoria.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I knew I was right. You were born for the silver screen!

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: But I suppose that's all moot if you have other business to attend to. I guess I'll be going home empty-handed.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Can I see the script?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: This rough draft is just the starting line. I'll give it the time, manpower, and money it needs to become a masterpiece that will leave its mark on cinema history.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: And I guarantee that you'll shine, even with just a minor role in a single scene.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I also wouldn't worry about your, um... little health issues. Wrankwood has special protections in place for Infected actors, so long as you pay for proper insurance—

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: You may call me Lucian, Madam Stone.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I will consider your proposal.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Let me apologize again, Lucian.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: This is your first time working on a film, and you signed the contract after careful consideration. You deserved to experience the joy of cinema I'd promised you.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: But who could have imagined such a terrible accident happening on your first film shoot in Wrankwood?

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: I'd understand if you need some time to process things. I'll have Shelly reschedule your next scene.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: But I'm afraid there's no way to cancel your contract and leave the cast now. The plate has already moved beyond the range of short-haul transports, and won't return until the lease expires.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I'm not leaving.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: And there's no need to reschedule.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Are you sure? Trauma like that could easily affect your performance, let alone your daily life.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I'm no stranger to surprises on the stage.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Performing on stage like you're used to definitely has more unpredictability than in front of a camera. Still, they're just plays.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: 'Plays'... perhaps.
The mysterious and elegant creature once again shows up by Lucian's feet, rubbing herself against the Feline's calves, seemingly oblivious to Greta's presence.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Are you sure you don't need rest, Lucian? I wouldn't mind letting you enjoy Miss.Christine's company a while longer.

spans.text: you don't need rest, Lucian? I wouldn't mind letting you enjoy Miss.Christine's company a while longer.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: She's looking forward to the next part of the story. As am I.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Hm. You're much calmer about this than I expected... But I suppose it would be tactless of me to say anything more.

steps.name: Greta
steps.text: Then I'll see you on the set tomorrow.
The mysterious and elegant creature grooms her fur, then gazes at Lucian, as though deep in thought.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Miss.Christine?
Her two tails sway freely in the air, drawing blurry shadows.
She floats up and orbits Lucian's shoulders, perhaps observing, perhaps savoring.
Finally, the beautiful creature sits upon Lucian's knees, placing one paw on his forehead. Lucian feels a comforting warmth.
Lucian hears a mysterious voice in the empty room. He does not bother looking for its source, instead gazing into Miss Christine's eyes, still as a statue.
He knows she is projecting these words into his mind.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Stealth and silence are your ways of avoiding trouble. You rarely talk unless necessary.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Do my emotions taste that bad?

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: It's not a bad flavor. I like trying new things, even if they're not always to my taste.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: What are you thinking about? That long-winded snake could not have incited such complex emotions.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: One of many memories of my life in the Troupe.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The Troupe Leader saw that I was a fast learner and personally instructed me in the use of weapons.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: When I held that knife in my hands, I felt exactly the same as I did that day.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Then I understand the spiciness, and the sweetness of the aftertaste.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: The conflicts and struggles you experienced at the Troupe, those things humans call pain and tragedy, have been transformed into an alluring meal. I like it.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Even after killing him, I've continued to search for him.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: The remaining Troupe cultists, the strange rumors in remote villages, and that ostentatious mark... Along the way, I've been trying to verify a hypothesis that has been floating in the back of my mind.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: That perhaps he has come back to life.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: The story that the snake is filming has quite the strange flavor, one that is most addictive.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Thank you for reminding me. While flipping through the script, I saw the twin-faced seal of the Troupe engraved in the gaps between pages.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: What seems coincidence for the characters is always deliberate design of the author. Madam Stone, seemingly unrelated to the Troupe, has become our guide.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: Yet I was still not certain. The riddles he left behind are mixed with lies and half-truths, as we know only too well from these past ten years.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: That is, until Dalton died by my blade today, and my memories of the past were awakened by the familiar sensation...

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: This is an invitation from him.

steps.name: Lucian
steps.text: I think... we've come to the right place, Miss.Christine.

steps.name: Miss.Christine
steps.text: Mrrow~
